thread:
Alex: Heads up — saw a regression in canary where mixtral-8b requests with head_dim=48 are often routed to the slow fallback, p50 token latency up ~2.2x. Repro + traces below.
Maria: Can you paste the profiler output and a repro command?
Alex: Sure — minimal reproducer: run with model=mixtral-8b, prompt length 256 prefix cached, decode 64. Profiler snippet: 
```
kernel_selection: sdpa_fast: 12 calls, sdpa_slow: 87 calls
latency_ms: sdpa_fast p50 1.9, sdpa_slow p50 4.6
fallback_reason: head_dim_not_aligned
```
Also seeing increased kv-prefetch misses and masked-token handling in logs.
Chen: Interesting — head_dim_not_aligned suggests our relaxed divisibility check in routing lets some 48/80 head dims try the optimized SDPA/Triton path. Masking + cached KV seems to expose a masking-edge bug in the fast kernel. Which sequence lengths?
Alex: Happens when prefix cache exists and continuing decode length pushes total seq > 256. Reproducer attached to the thread (small script). Also had a RoPE assert once during stress.
Sam: I bisected to PR #2345 (routing heuristics change) — the change removed the explicit head_dim%16 requirement to let some odd head widths use SDPA. Quick mitigation: revert to stricter check and gate SDPA/Triton fast path to head_dim%8==0 && !kv_cached_masked. I'll push a canary branch.
Maria: We need a regression test in the kernel selection harness before merging. Can we add a dedicated mixtral-48 head test with cached prefix?
Lorenzo: I can add that to ci/perf-harness. I'll add mixtral-48 + qwen-80 cases and assert that fast_path only used when mask semantics safe. Also adding an explicit fallback check in the tracer.
infra-bot: Deploy bot: canary route updated to rev ab12 with routing patch (sam/fix-kernel-routing).
Alex: Canary results on ab12: p50 returned to baseline for mixtral-8b. Fallback rate dropped from ~22% to 3%. However, qwen-14b saw throughput regression when forced to Triton fallback — batching overhead kicks in.
Chen: For Triton fallback we should tune the batching heuristics (increase max_batch_tokens and allow longer batch windows for fallback to amortize kernel startup). Also add KV-prefetch-aware batching: if request has cached KV, prefer batching those to avoid per-request overhead.
Sam: I'll open a follow-up PR for batching and add a per-model fallback_rate metric and alert. Patch will include: bump max_batch_tokens for fallback, introduce kv_prefetch tag in batcher, and a histogram for fallback latency.
Maria: Plan + owners: 1) merge routing revert (sam) 2) add regression test (lorenzo) 3) batching heuristics PR (sam + chen) 4) add fallback_rate >1% alert and dashboard (maria).
Chen: Also filing a tracking issue for the RoPE assert — might be related to how fast kernel scales RoPE offsets for unaligned heads. I'll investigate with unit tests.
Sam: Sounds good. Thanks all — follow-up PRs linked in thread when ready. :thumbsup:
Maria: Nice catch, Alex. Good to see canary caught it.
Alex: Thanks — will keep monitoring.
